interpretation_note: TOST equivalence and the original gate are distinct. A test can fail equivalence yet pass the original gate by direct superiority; that is what occurs here.

tests.direct_superiority_rule: direct superiority if the upper bound of the paired 95% CI for candidate-reference is below zero
tests.effect_definition: candidate - reference; negative favors the preservation student
tests.estimand: scene-weighted, replicate-averaged ES(candidate)-ES(reference); conditions are averaged within scene before replicates are averaged
tests.margin_type: relative to the scene-weighted mean reference energy, converted to absolute energy-score bounds
tests.original_gate_rule: pass by either direct superiority or TOST equivalence
tests.replicate_combination: Per replicate: target differences averaged within scene, then across listed conditions. Across replicates: matched scene effects averaged. CI: 10,000 paired scene bootstrap resamples with seed 20260805.
tests.tost_rule: equivalent only if the entire two-sided 90% bootstrap CI lies strictly inside [-0.02*mean(reference ES), +0.02*mean(reference ES)]
